tasks.name: airfoil_self_noise
tasks.prediction_context: Predict the supplied continuous sound-pressure target from measured airflow, geometry and frequency. Standard IID benchmark split; not an extrapolation test for new aircraft geometries.

tasks.name: concrete_compressive_strength
tasks.prediction_context: Predict concrete compressive strength for a specified mix and curing age. Age is known for the requested prediction. Some identical feature settings occur in train and test; their measured share is reported in the suitability review.

tasks.name: credit-g
tasks.prediction_context: Predict the historical good/bad credit label from the supplied applicant attributes. IID benchmark classification; not a modern credit-approval policy or cost-sensitive official score.

tasks.name: eryhemato_squamous_disease
tasks.prediction_context: Retrospective six-class diagnosis from observed clinical and histopathological measurements, including biopsy-derived features. Not a prediction before these measurements; the cohort is small and this is an ML benchmark, not a clinical validation.

tasks.name: student_portuguese_performance
tasks.prediction_context: Static prediction of final grade G3 with all supplied covariates, including observed absences. G1 and G2 are excluded by the curator. Do not describe this as an enrollment-time or causal prediction.

tasks.name: fiat_500
tasks.prediction_context: Estimate the supplied listing price from the vehicle model, age, engine power, mileage, ownership count and location. IID listing regression; a small share of identical feature profiles is reported in the suitability review.

tasks.name: qsar_biodeg
tasks.prediction_context: Classify ready biodegradability from supplied molecular structural descriptors. IID chemical benchmark; not a test of generalization to disjoint chemical scaffolds.

tasks.name: predict_students_dropout_and_academic_success
tasks.prediction_context: Retrospective classification of final academic outcome using the supplied covariates, including academic performance in semesters 1 and 2. Not an enrollment-time early-warning forecast; timestamp-specific prospective validity is not established.

tasks.name: video_game_fps_prediction
tasks.prediction_context: Predict log FPS ratio for unseen CPU/GPU configurations on known games, relative to the curator fixed reference hardware. Not raw-FPS prediction or generalization to unseen games.

tasks.name: abalone
tasks.prediction_context: Predict the supplied rings count from physical measurements. Do not silently relabel rings as exact age in years.

tasks.name: polish_companies_bankruptcy
tasks.prediction_context: Predict one-year-ahead bankruptcy status from the supplied company financial ratios in the curated year-5 subset. The split is IID across records, not a chronological evaluation on a later calendar period. Missing values and extreme ratios are present.

tasks.name: cardiotocography
tasks.prediction_context: Classify fetal-state categories from recording measurements for held-out patient groups; use supplied retrospective recorded measurements.

tasks.name: 5g_energy_consumption
tasks.prediction_context: Estimate energy under known load and configuration for held-out base stations in a similar period. This is not forecasting future load or evaluating a future time shift.

tasks.name: grid_stability
tasks.prediction_context: Surrogate regression for a published simulated electrical-grid stability model; these are simulation samples, not independently measured real-grid incidents. Alternate target stabf is excluded.

tasks.name: credit_card_clients_default
tasks.prediction_context: Predict next-month payment default from the supplied preceding billing and repayment history. Historical IID borrower split; not validation of a future calendar-period shift.

tasks.name: mice_protein_trisomy_discriminant
tasks.prediction_context: Classify the eight genotype/treatment/behavior classes from measured proteins in unseen mice. Constituent target fields are excluded; use the original mouse-grouped split.
